QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_1

question.text: Lotus Growth AIF, a Category II fund launched by Mr. Ramesh Iyer, is drafting its PPM. During the commitment period, what is the INDUSTRY-STANDARD base on which the management fee is typically charged for a Category II AIF?

answer.text: Gross Net Asset Value (GNAV) of the fund
Net Asset Value net of management fees

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 9, Category I and II AIF management fees are typically charged as a percentage of Committed Capital during the commitment period. After the commitment period, the base may step down (for example, to invested capital or AUM). The Trap: Option B (GNAV) is the Cat III convention. Option C is a common post-commitment-period base but not during the commitment period. Option D confuses fee calculation direction. Note: Workbook pages 125 and 147 support the committed-capital fee base during the commitment period and the possibility of a post-commitment step-down.
